children: Ultragenyx announced FDA full approval of FAYUVI for pediatric MPS IIIA, marking the company's second gene therapy approval.
FDA granted standard full approval for FAYUVI (rebisufligene etisparvovec-hopf) to treat pediatric MPS IIIA.
FAYUVI is the first FDA-approved therapy for Sanfilippo syndrome Type A, addressing a progressive, fatal neurodegenerative disease.
Approval represents Ultragenyx's second gene therapy approval, expanding its rare-disease portfolio.
Company received a Priority Review Voucher in connection with the approval.
